failed_gate_routes: no human branch decision: keep A1 prepared-not-authorized and do not start any clock
locator or hash changes at send time: stop and rebind packet before any contact
delivery failure only: record failed-send shell without treating it as counterparty response
auto-ack or bot form receipt: preserve as transport-adjacent metadata, not human response
decline or referral: preserve raw response privately and issue public shell only after custody gate
open_blockers: raw human response or reasoned failed-contact shell
public_summary: The field capture workbook turns the next external move into a six-row evidence capture plan. It does not authorize contact or count any internal draft as a field artifact.
